name: 兽花蕾
description: 稀兽花种的幼年形态，非常轻，会随风而动，身后有像翅膀一样的苞片，苞片上有特殊的薄膜，可以起到防风防水的效果，保护它们健康成长。
descriptionEn: The juvenile form of the rare beast flower species. It is very light and drifts with the wind. Behind it are wing-like bracts covered with a special membrane that is windproof and waterproof, protecting them as they grow up healthy.

skills.name: 汲取
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage and drains 100% of the damage as HP.

skills.name: 镜像反射
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：本技能变为被应对的技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; when countering an attack: this skill becomes the skill being countered.

skills.name: 透射
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 顶端优势
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 退化
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 1 stack of Cute Form.

skills.name: 过曝
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每使用过1个其他系别技能，本技能威力永久+30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each skill of another type used, this skill's power is permanently +30.

skills.name: 漫反射
skills.description: 每种系别中的至多1个技能，威力+35。
skills.descriptionEn: Up to 1 skill of each type gains power +35.

skills.name: 迫近攻击
skills.description: 造成物伤。每次使用后，本技能威力永久+45。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. After each use, this skill's power is permanently +45.

skills.name: 移花接木
skills.description: 自己回复15%生命，随后脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: The user restores 15% HP, then withdraws.

skills.name: 叶绿光束
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 放晴
skills.description: 光系技能威力永久+50%，应对防御：改为永久+100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Light-type skills' power is permanently +50%; countering defense: instead permanently +100%.

skills.name: 芳香诱引
skills.description: 自己获得连击数+2，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains combo count +2; when countering a defense: additionally causes an interruption, and the opponent gains stun next turn.
